import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SymbolicPrefix246
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame

/-!
Per-instruction contracts for the literal prefix246 machine.

Direct port of the checked SitePrefix250 contracts to the contextual folds.
Adapted from the maintained SitePerm252 and Mira-Cult and Jeff's
`ZF/m254/coq/tm/Site.v`, upstream commit
297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3, using Wade's path semantics.
The original physical register assignment is retained. Every binary step
uses the proved exact246 symbolic executor; no register-operation
hypothesis is supplied.

The arbitrary gap parameter and overflow marker convention are retained.
Positive decrement shifts the register header one cell right, represented
by extra = 1 in its target distance. Every other operation uses extra = 0.
Increment's appended value-one spare and zero decrement's return through
old112 are already explicit in SymbolicPrefix246. Every valid physical
file has at least ten blocks, providing the required following block.

This module proves soundness of individual successful checks. Complete
coverage of the original 8,391 instruction cases, nonempty-spare frame
preservation, and the blank bootstrap remain separate obligations.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix246

open RegisterPath SymbolicPrefix246

def dispatch : Fin 246 := dispatchPrefix246
def minDistance : Nat := 40
def fuel : Nat := 4000

def physical (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) : Reg :=
  ⟨Permutation252Frame.physOf r, Permutation252Frame.physOf_lt ⟨r, hr⟩⟩

def allOnes (P : List Bool) : Bool := P.all id

def start (Q : List Bool) : SConfig :=
  ⟨some dispatch, false, [.bit true],
    Q.map Segment.bit ++
      [.run false 1 (minDistance - Q.length), .bit true, .box (.plain .unchanged)]⟩

def target (P : List Bool) (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) : SConfig :=
  ⟨some dispatch, false, [.bit true],
    P.map Segment.bit ++
      [.run false 1 (minDistance + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length),
       .bit true, .box x]⟩

def runTo (br : Branch) (Q : List Bool) (wanted : SConfig) : Bool :=
  verifies fuel br (start Q) wanted

def runHalt (Q : List Bool) : Bool := verifiesHalt fuel none (start Q)

def checkOperation (Q : List Bool) : Edge → Bool
  | .node _ => false
  | .inc r =>
      if hr : r < 9 then
        runTo none Q (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0 (.plain (.increment (physical r hr))))
      else false
  | .decnz r =>
      if hr : r < 9 then
        runTo (some (physical r hr, true)) Q
          (target (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) &&
        runTo (some (physical r hr, false)) Q
          (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 (.plain (.decrement (physical r hr))))
      else false
  | .brk k =>
      runTo none Q (target (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged))
  | .cont k => runTo none Q (target (continuePath k Q) false 0 (.plain .unchanged))
  | .halt => runHalt Q

/-- The distance bound is checked together with the operation, so every
accepted leaf can be used with the same arbitrary nonnegative gap parameter. -/
def checkSite (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) : Bool :=
  decide (Q.length ≤ minDistance) && checkOperation Q e

theorem checkSite_length (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) (h : checkSite Q e = true) :
    Q.length ≤ minDistance := by
  exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).1

theorem checkSite_operation (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) (h : checkSite Q e = true) :
    checkOperation Q e = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).2

theorem runTo_sound (br : Branch) (Q : List Bool) (wanted : SConfig)
    (he : runTo br Q wanted = true)
    (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (hv : Valid br vs) (c : Config 246)
    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ Represents n vs wanted (machinePrefix246.runFrom c k) :=
  verifies_sound fuel br (start Q) wanted he n vs hv c hc

theorem runHalt_sound (Q : List Bool) (he : runHalt Q = true)
    (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (hv : 10 ≤ vs.length) (c : Config 246)
    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ (machinePrefix246.runFrom c k).state = none :=
  verifiesHalt_sound fuel none (start Q) he n vs ⟨hv, trivial⟩ c hc

theorem check_inc (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0 (.plain (.increment (physical r hr)))) = true := by
  simpa only [checkOperation, dif_pos hr] using checkSite_operation Q (.inc r) h

theorem check_decnz (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    runTo (some (physical r hr, true)) Q
      (target (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true ∧
    runTo (some (physical r hr, false)) Q
      (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 (.plain (.decrement (physical r hr)))) = true := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.decnz r) h
  simpa only [checkOperation, dif_pos hr, Bool.and_eq_true_iff] using hc

theorem check_break (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat)
    (h : checkSite Q (.brk k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true :=
  checkSite_operation Q (.brk k) h

theorem check_continue (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat)
    (h : checkSite Q (.cont k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (continuePath k Q) false 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true :=
  checkSite_operation Q (.cont k) h

theorem check_halt (Q : List Bool) (h : checkSite Q .halt = true) : runHalt Q = true :=
  checkSite_operation Q .halt h

theorem check_inc_bound (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    r < 9 := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.inc r) h
  by_cases hr : r < 9
  · exact hr
  · simp only [checkOperation, dif_neg hr, Bool.false_eq_true] at hc

theorem check_decnz_bound (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    r < 9 := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.decnz r) h
  by_cases hr : r < 9
  · exact hr
  · simp only [checkOperation, dif_neg hr, Bool.false_eq_true] at hc

theorem check_node_false (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) : checkSite Q (.node r) = false := by
  simp only [checkSite, checkOperation, Bool.and_false]

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix246

    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :

example (Q : List Bool) (he : runHalt Q = true)
    (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (hv : 10 ≤ vs.length) (c : Config 246)
    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ (machinePrefix246.runFrom c k).state = none :=
  runHalt_sound Q he n vs hv c hc

example (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0
      (.plain (.increment (physical r hr)))) = true := check_inc Q r hr h

example (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    runTo (some (physical r hr, true)) Q
      (target (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true ∧
    runTo (some (physical r hr, false)) Q
      (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 (.plain (.decrement (physical r hr)))) = true :=
  check_decnz Q r hr h

example (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.brk k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0
      (.plain .unchanged)) = true := check_break Q k h

example (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.cont k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (continuePath k Q) false 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true :=
  check_continue Q k h

example (Q : List Bool) (h : checkSite Q .halt = true) :
    runHalt Q = true := check_halt Q h

example (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    r < 9 := check_inc_bound Q r h

example (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    r < 9 := check_decnz_bound Q r h

example (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) :
    checkSite Q (.node r) = false := check_node_false Q r

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact246 per-site soundness proof,17 exact prerequisite providers.
Compiles only SitePrefix246 and its audit, serially, using checked Symbolic
and maintained table-parametric frame providers. Prepare-only performs no
compiler/version query. No dependency rebuild, downloads or enlarged options.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
MODULE='BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix246'
PREFIX='SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitePrefix246.'
SOURCE_SHA='622c8b819df930b741a34c429b3911a1cc18e4a1e8f1582311e281fc24b844e2'
AUDIT_SHA='54202e5803564eb4fb158e9c02b070532f20bd3a92ec7912da64f283da55ab67'
MP_RECORD_SHA='92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED={'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Table253': ('c92520ae03c56dded064aa6a9d348a78e9f7f11973cd002a72e0bfd4a5503c08', 'd75e2c32164212f49d61bd7bf910133523deb158f879f8b7d3c81973e47a038c'), 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterBoxes253': ('d59106c98b5cf089989df16b0d98068965c00f651e3bfc822a9d2d6ef39fbe21', 'e08ec6fc4478520e1acccc71c7f2e35abd2644a813e8a569cad20a9481f91ced'), 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterPath': ('a1457f32034eb4da50c8755610a366805260aac711424bba8b516ccab4e5b879', '629b3a81651ae48578195e5d0fd4f2eee02d4633544ab08686331a4ef0c392b7'), 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame': ('63a3c9d9358a3a24edfef7889ffcc96d00f2aab3f2dd752c944c4f0e84236ae7', '38c3b71899b6e65bcf91e60d1e8ac104a84052b833cce21038159f98dfc52d96')}
PROBES=['checkSite_length', 'checkSite_operation', 'runTo_sound', 'runHalt_sound', 'check_inc', 'check_decnz', 'check_break', 'check_continue', 'check_halt', 'check_inc_bound', 'check_decnz_bound', 'check_node_false']
CALLERS=13
TIMEOUT=120
PARENTS={'symbolic':('bc645cbef2250dcc8adc989640f995a075e5d6d987393789a15b960cb2ad920e','BusyBeaver.ZFC.SymbolicPrefix246')}
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo',type=Path,required=True)
for label in PARENTS:p.add_argument('--'+label+'-evidence',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--source',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only',action='store_true')
a=p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha=lambda f:hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R=a.repo.resolve();W=a.output.resolve()
assert all(not pin.startswith('PENDING_') for pin,module in PARENTS.values()), 'Freeze exact successful parent record before preparation or proof run.'
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
S=a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix246-lean/site/SitePrefix246.lean')
A=a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix246-lean/site/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S)==SOURCE_SHA and sha(A)==AUDIT_SHA
MP=R/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(MP)==MP_RECORD_SHA
mp=json.loads(MP.read_text())
C=Path(mp['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert sha(C)==mp['compiler']['sha256']
version=mp['compiler']['version'];toolroot=C.parent.parent/'lib/lean'
def imports(path):
 return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$',Path(path).read_text(),re.M)
def passed(d):
 assert d['status']=='PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
 assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
 assert len(d['commands'])==2 and [q['label'] for q in d['commands']]==['source','audit']
 assert all(q['exit_code']==0 for q in d['commands'])
 assert d['compiler']['sha256']==sha(C) and d['compiler']['version']==version
passed(mp)
assert imports(S)==['BusyBeaver.ZFC.SymbolicPrefix246','BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame']
assert imports(A)==[MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$',A.read_text(),re.M)==['SitePrefix246.'+n for n in PROBES]
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b',A.read_text(),re.M))==CALLERS
for f in (S,A):
 assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b',f.read_text())
 assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)',f.read_text())
selected={};evidence={str(MP):sha(MP)};parent_snapshots=[];parent_summaries=[]
def add_provider(q,e):
 m=q['module'];s=Path(q['source']).resolve();o=Path(q['object']).resolve()
 assert sha(s)==q['source_sha256'] and sha(o)==q['object_sha256']
 row=dict(module=m,source=str(s),source_sha256=sha(s),object=str(o),object_sha256=sha(o),evidence=str(e))
 if m in selected:
  assert (selected[m]['source_sha256'],selected[m]['object_sha256'])==(row['source_sha256'],row['object_sha256'])
 else:selected[m]=row
pool={q['module']:q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
for m,(ss,oo) in EXPECTED.items():
 q=pool[m];s=R/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean'/Path(m.replace('.','/')).with_suffix('.lean')
 assert sha(s)==ss==q['source_sha256'] and q['object_sha256']==oo
 add_provider(dict(q,source=str(s)),MP)
for label,(pin,module) in PARENTS.items():
 E=getattr(a,label+'_evidence').resolve();assert sha(E)==pin
 parent=json.loads(E.read_text());passed(parent);evidence[str(E)]=pin
 for q in parent['reused_modules']:add_provider(q,E)
 fresh=[q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module']==module];assert len(fresh)==1
 q=fresh[0];s=Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve();snap=Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
 assert q['source_sha256']==parent['source']['sha256']==sha(s)==sha(snap)
 assert sha(q['path'])==q['sha256']
 add_provider(dict(module=module,source=str(s),source_sha256=sha(s),object=q['path'],object_sha256=q['sha256']),E)
 parent_snapshots.append(snap)
 recorded=parent.get('source_object_recorded_before_audit',False)
 assert recorded and parent['source_pass_object']==q
 parent_summaries.append(dict(label=label,evidence=str(E),module=module,
  source_object_recorded_before_audit=recorded,source_sha256=sha(s),object_sha256=q['sha256']))
 for ref in parent.get('provider_evidence',parent.get('parent_evidence',[])):
  f=Path(ref['path']).resolve();assert sha(f)==ref['sha256']
  passed(json.loads(f.read_text()));evidence[str(f)]=ref['sha256']
visiting, closure, tool_names = set(), [], {'Init'}
def visit(m):
    if m in closure:
        return
    assert m in selected and m not in visiting
    visiting.add(m)
    for n in imports(selected[m]['source']):
        if n == 'Init' or n.startswith(('Lean.', 'Std.')):
            tool_names.add(n)
        else:
            visit(n)
    visiting.remove(m)
    closure.append(m)
for m in imports(S):
    visit(m)
assert set(closure) == set(selected) and len(closure) == 17
W.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache, snap = W / 'cache', W / 'sources'
cache.mkdir()
ss = snap / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
ss.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
aa = snap / 'Audit.lean'
shutil.copyfile(S, ss)
shutil.copyfile(A, aa)
for m in closure:
    dest = cache / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.symlink_to(selected[m]['object'])
def first(m):
    rel = Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    return next(q / rel for q in (cache, toolroot) if (q / rel).is_file())
actual = []
for m in closure:
    obj = first(m)
    assert sha(obj) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    actual.append(dict(module=m, actual_first=str(obj), resolved=str(obj.resolve()), sha256=sha(obj)))
tools = []
for m in sorted(tool_names):
    ref = toolroot / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    obj = first(m)
    assert obj.resolve() == ref.resolve()
    tools.append(dict(module=m, object=str(ref), object_sha256=sha(ref), actual_first=str(obj)))
inputs = [Path(__file__).resolve(), S, A, MP, C, ss, aa] + [Path(f) for f in evidence] + parent_snapshots
for q in selected.values():
    inputs += [Path(q['source']), Path(q['object'])]
inputs += [Path(q['object']) for q in tools]
inputs = list(dict.fromkeys(q.resolve() for q in inputs))
before = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
env = dict(os.environ, LEAN_PATH=str(cache), LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r = dict(status='PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' if a.prepare_only else 'RUNNING', scope=__doc__,
    prepare_only=a.prepare_only, compiler=dict(path=str(C), version=version, sha256=sha(C),
    compiler_version_query_performed=False), source_overridden=a.source is not None,
    audit_overridden=a.audit is not None, source=dict(path=str(S), sha256=sha(S), snapshot=str(ss)),
    audit=dict(path=str(A), sha256=sha(A), snapshot=str(aa)),
    provider_evidence=[dict(path=f, sha256=h) for f,h in evidence.items()], parent_summaries=parent_summaries,
    reused_modules=[selected[m] for m in closure], exact_project_import_closure=True,
    project_module_count=17, external_project_boundaries=[], toolchain_providers=tools,
    actual_first_providers=actual, actual_direct_tool_imports=sorted(tool_names),
    before=before, commands=[], fresh_modules=[], LEAN_PATH=env['LEAN_PATH'],
    dependency_build=False, downloads=False, per_command_timeout_seconds=TIMEOUT,
    shared_wall_seconds=TIMEOUT)
def save():
    (W / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
def post():
    after = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
    assert before == after
    for m in closure:
        assert sha(first(m)) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    for q in tools:
        assert sha(first(q['module'])) == q['object_sha256']
    r.update(after=after, all_input_provider_postchecks=True)
save()
if a.prepare_only:
    post()
    save()
    print(W / 'verification.json')
    raise SystemExit(0)
deadline = time.monotonic() + TIMEOUT
def run(label, source, obj=None):
    cmd = [str(C), '-j1', '-M4096', '--root=' + str(snap)]
    if obj is not None:
        cmd += ['-o', str(obj)]
    cmd += [str(source)]
    began = time.monotonic()
    remaining = deadline - began
    assert remaining > 0, 'Shared proof wall budget exhausted.'
    try:
        cp = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=snap, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=remaining)
        output, code = cp.stdout + cp.stderr, cp.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        def decoded(x):
            return x.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(x, bytes) else x or ''
        output, code = decoded(ex.stdout) + decoded(ex.stderr) + '\nTIMEOUT\n', -1
    (W / (label + '.log')).write_text(output)
    r['commands'].append(dict(label=label, command=cmd, seconds=time.monotonic() - began,
                              exit_code=code, output=output))
    save()
    assert code == 0 and 'sorryAx' not in output and "declaration uses 'sorry'" not in output, output
    return output
try:
    obj = cache / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    run('source', ss, obj)
    assert obj.is_file() and not obj.is_symlink()
    oh = sha(obj)
    source_object = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(obj), sha256=oh, source_sha256=sha(S))
    r.update(source_object_recorded_before_audit=True, source_pass_object=source_object,
             fresh_modules=[source_object])
    assert first(MODULE).resolve() == obj.resolve()
    r['fresh_first_provider_before_audit'] = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(first(MODULE)), sha256=sha(first(MODULE)))
    save()
    audit_output = run('audit', aa)
    reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)'\s+(?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)", audit_output, re.S)
    assert [n for n, _ in reports] == [PREFIX + n for n in PROBES]
    assert all({x.strip() for x in axioms.split(',') if x.strip()} <=
               {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'} for _, axioms in reports)
    post()
    assert sha(obj) == oh and sha(first(MODULE)) == oh
    r.update(status='PASS', all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit=True,
             named_axiom_probes=len(PROBES), callers=CALLERS, only_standard_axioms=True,
             warnings={q['label']: q['output'].count('warning:') for q in r['commands']})
except Exception as ex:
    r.update(status='FAIL', error=str(ex))
    try:
        post()
    except Exception as post_error:
        r['postcheck_error'] = str(post_error)
    save()
    raise
save()
print(W / 'verification.json')
